expectations.name: crash_dump_area
expectations.rationale: Reserved for crash-dump recovery after watchdog reset; must survive the boot ROM untouched.

expectations.name: rom_stack
expectations.rationale: Known ROM scratch / stack area; if this ever looks SAFE the ROM probably failed to run.

expectations.name: shared_buffer
expectations.rationale: Either preserved (warm reset) or cleanly zeroed (cold reset). Never garbage.
